sections.content:
Spanish distinguishes verbs of change through intention, speed, and permanence:
• Ponerse: sudden & temporary emotion/physical state
• Quedarse: consequence, aftermath, loss
• Volverse: radical & lasting character shift
• Hacerse: effort, profession, ideology
• Convertirse en: transformation into a new entity.

sections.title: Quick Reference Table
rows: Se hizo abogado / Se convirtió en éxito

items.spanish: Al oír la noticia se puso pálido y se quedó mudo.
items.english: On hearing the news he turned pale and was struck dumb.

items.spanish: Estudió con dedicación y se hizo médico.
items.english: He studied with dedication and became a doctor.

sections.content: Avoid using *volverse* for temporary feelings: say *me puse triste*, not *me volví triste*.
